title: No Ramscoop Engines trait evidence and controlled observation

provenance.location: TOPICPOS 1821323 (0x001bca8b), HLP file offset 460928 (0x00070880), topic 276 'No Ramscoop Engines'
provenance.note: Decoded help topic for No Ramscoop Engines; documented-only claim, not a runtime observation.

provenance.location: dialog #150 resource at file offset 0x2fab00, candidate control 298 (caption empty; position-based lead only); no literal 'No Ramscoop Engines' ASCII string was found in the executable by exact-byte search
provenance.note: Executable location of the trait name/control is a lead; it does not prove runtime mechanics.

setup.baseline: A custom race with no other selected trait and otherwise identical wizard choices.
setup.variable: Select only No Ramscoop Engines and record the advantage-point balance and observable effects.
setup.universe: Single-player, fixed small universe with one Turindrones opponent if the runtime exposes it (otherwise record the actual opponent), fixed difficulty, no random events; keep the same seed/settings across trials.

procedure: Create the baseline race and record the step 1-6 settings and advantage-point balance.
Create the same race with only No Ramscoop Engines changed; record the exact advantage-point balance and any disabled controls.
Start the game and record starting technology, planets, fleets, installations and available catalog entries.
Run a controlled comparison for each documented effect, varying one input at a time and repeating at least three trials where randomness may apply.
Record the observed result, game year, settings and any discrepancy from the documented claim.

documented: The Radiating Hydro-Ram Scoop, Sub-Galactic Fuel Scoop, Trans-Galactic Fuel Scoop, Trans-Galactic Super Scoop, Trans-Galactic Mizer Scoop and Galaxy Scoop are unavailable (documented-only).
The Interspace-10 engine is available and can travel warp 10 without taking damage (documented-only).

unresolved: The exact engine catalog identifiers and the full exclusion set are not decoded.
Warp-10 damage immunity and its interaction with Cheap Engines are unknown.
notes: The help is dated January 1998 and its applicability to stars26i.exe is unverified. No original-game execution is claimed by PR2.
